title: AWS confirms permanent data loss for customers hosted only in Bahrain after March conflict damage
summary: Amazon Web Services has confirmed it cannot restore data held only in parts of its Middle East regions damaged in the conflict with Iran, formalising a months-long outage as a permanent write-off for some workloads. In a status update, AWS said damage in Bahrain 'spanned multiple Availability Zones and exceeded what our regional and multi-AZ services are designed to withstand.' Data hosted only in the mec1-az2 zone of me-central-1 (UAE) cannot be recovered; AWS now steers customers to other regions and cites Bahrain restoration in early 2027.
